feed.text: Jets great Mark Gastineau wants rookie David Bailey to celebrate after sacks. Gastineau's sack dances led to the NFL penalizing excessive celebrations for over 30 years.

feed.text: Ex-Broncos exec John Beake, who helped land John Elway, dies at 87. John Beake, who was instrumental in the trade for John Elway and helped guide the Denver Broncos to back-to-back Super Bowl titles in the late 1990s, has died at age 87, the team said Saturday.

feed.text: 49ers rule out Bosa for Monday, still hopeful for Evans, Juszczyk. The San Francisco 49ers will have to wait at least another week for the return of defensive end Nick Bosa, though there's at least a chance they'll have both receiver Mike Evans and fullback Kyle Juszczyk for Mond

feed.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot, expected to be out indefinitely. The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

feed.author: ESPN
feed.text: Sources: Bears plan to start QB Caleb Williams in Week 6 vs. Falcons. The Bears are planning to start Caleb Williams against the Falcons after the star QB missed the past three games, sources told NFL Network and ESPN.

feed.author: Adam Schefter
feed.text: He’s back: The Bears are planning to start Caleb Williams after he missed the past three games due to a torn hamstring but went through a full week of practice this week without any setbacks, per  NFLN and ESPN.

feed.author: Adam Schefter
feed.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to their 53-man roster. He is expected to play Sunday versus the Jets.

feed.author: Brooke Pryor
feed.text: Steelers place Wilson on IR with finger injury. The Pittsburgh Steelers placed Roman Wilson on the injured reserve list, their second key receiver lost to injury in as many weeks.

feed.author: Ian Rapoport
feed.text:
Breaking: After consultations with numerous doctors and experts that went into Saturday, the Eagles are placing quarterback Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources tell Adam Schefter and me.

Hurts is now out for the foreseeable future. More information coming…

feed.author: Adam Schefter
feed.text: Breaking: After consultations with numerous doctors and experts that went into Saturday, the Eagles are placing quarterback Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources tell @rapsheet and me. The move will sideline Hurts indefinitely.

feed.author: Courtney Cronin
feed.text: Bears CB Kyler Gordon set for 2026 debut after PUP activation. Bears nickel corner Kyler Gordon has been activated off the PUP list and could make his season debut against the Falcons.

feed.author: Mike Kaye
feed.text: Taylor Moton among 3 Panthers activated ahead of Eagles game. The Panthers will have RT Taylor Moton and DE Tershawn Wharton available Sunday against the Eagles. RB Trevor Etienne was also activated off IR.

feed.author: John Keim
feed.text: Commanders RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt out vs. 49ers with groin injury. Commanders running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt won't play against the 49ers because of a groin injury, coach Dan Quinn said.

feed.author: Mike Reiss
feed.text: Source: Patriots likely to activate WR A.J. Brown for Sunday's game vs. Jets. Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is likely to be activated Saturday after missing the last four games with a right high-ankle sprain, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

feed.author: Michael Dirocco
feed.text: Jags unlikely to play 3 international games in 2027 during EverBank renovations. Jaguars team president Mark Lamping said the team is unlikely to play three international home games in 2027 while renovations to EverBank Stadium continue.

feed.author: Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter
feed.text: Sources: Eagles' Jalen Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR. The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.

feed.author: Adam Schefter
feed.text: The Philadelphia Eagles are not planning to place quarterback Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told @RapSheet and me, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely because of a superficial blood clot.

feed.text: Where is the Tennessee Titans' pass rush?. The Titans invested more in the defensive front than any other area when Robert Saleh took over. So far, there hasn't been a significant ROI.

feed.text: Eagles' Saquon Barkley ruled out; DeVonta Smith to return. Eagles RB Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers with a hamstring injury, but it appears WR DeVonta Smith will return.

feed.author: Rob Demovsky
feed.text: Packers' Josh Jacobs eligible to return next week amid probe. Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.

feed.text: Decked-out, diehard Jaguars fans swarm London for pub takeover. Jaguars fans roll deep in the United Kingdom, and the fandom showed up big at London's briefly renamed ''Tealwood'' pub Thursday night.
